title: 重武器粉碎打击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：上、左、右。上段、左斩后，以右斩收尾，用重武器单手刺击对手的面部
second_page: 重武器的攻击很容易造成巨大的杀伤，特别是针对面部，比起用剑柄攻击敌人，重武器显然更加有效

en_us.title: Crushing Blow heavy weapon
en_us.first_page: Input: Up, Left, then Right. then stab with the heavy weapon straight to the face
en_us.second_page: instead of using a pommel to strike them in the face, a heavy weapon will clearly done the job better
